source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public 13–15, 16:1–35 and 18 align directly. Public 16:36–50 maps to Hebrew 17:1–15; public 17:1–13 maps to Hebrew 17:16–28. All 214 original records, including every annotation, are hashed exactly. Later numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Retains Aaron representing Levi and one-staff rationale without inventing an extra thirteenth staff. Hebrew 17:18.
Retains testimony rather than silently replacing it with ark; note explains covenant tablets and associated location. Hebrew 17:19.
Preserves sign, complaint cessation and death-prevention purpose; no invented later placement inside ark. Hebrew 17:25.
Retains three cries and repeated lost as frightened speech, not proof that all are already dead. Hebrew 17:27.
Preserves repeated approach and closing question that leads into chapter 18’s access distinctions. Hebrew 17:28.
